instruction: Take a screenshot from the VLC player showing the trailer and save it as 'trailer_shot.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing video screenshot and saving as 'trailer_shot.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) valid PNG, (3) size 10KB-50MB. State-based evaluation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator cannot verify screenshot content - only checks file existence, PNG format, and size
Critical semantic gap: Any PNG file at the target path with reasonable size would pass, even if not a VLC screenshot
False positives possible: blank images, screenshots of other apps, or unrelated PNG files would all pass
Instruction requires 'screenshot from VLC player showing the trailer' but evaluator cannot verify the content is actually from VLC or shows the trailer
Getter logic is correct for what it checks (file exists, is PNG, has reasonable size), but this is insufficient for instruction verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding image content verification (e.g., check dimensions match expected screenshot size, or verify image is not blank/uniform color)
Could add timestamp check to verify file was created during/after task execution
Consider using image similarity comparison with a reference VLC screenshot if feasible
Alternatively, simplify the instruction to 'Create a PNG file named trailer_shot.png on Desktop with reasonable size' to match what can actually be verified
